eligibility_call_pair.value: pairwise-complete rows >= 200 and sessions with such rows >= 10
eligibility_call_pair.reason: a session-clustered CI needs several clusters; 200 rows keeps rare tool timers out

feature_drop.value: dropped in a unit when <2 distinct non-null values, or non-null in <200 rows (calls) / <30 sessions

replication_rule.value: pair replicates in unit U when U's 95% CI excludes 0, has the discovery sign, and |rho_U| >= 0.1, using the same statistic (pooled / within / session / partial) as the discovery list
replication_rule.reason: 0.1 = smallest effect worth reporting at these n; fixed before computing

ranks.value: average ranks (scipy rankdata 'average') on pairwise-complete rows

bootstrap.value: 1000 replicates, seed 20261003, sessions resampled with replacement, fixed ranks

exact_rerank_check.value: top 10 pooled call pairs and top 10 session pairs per discovery unit, 200 replicates, re-ranked

tool_classes.reason: classes of the normalized IR tool name; Who&When agents folded into the nearest class

error_flag.value: err = 1 when the call's result has native_error True or a non-null extra.marker (lib/ir.error_marker); 0 when a result exists otherwise; null when no result
error_flag.reason: union of the two failure signals the IR carries

declared_definitional.value: two tool-class indicators; pos_idx-pos_rel; err-nerr; err_rate-nerr_rate; n_calls-n_results
declared_definitional.reason: mutually exclusive indicators or two codings of one quantity; flagged, excluded from *_excl lists

compaction_events.value: meta extra.entry_type=='system' & subtype=='compact_boundary' (Claude Code, aiv_cc); meta event_msg type 'context_compacted' (Codex); meta part_type 'compaction' (OpenCode)
compaction_events.reason: one count per harness compaction record

within_guard.rule: rho_within is null (within_degenerate=true) when the within-session rank variance of x or y is <= 1e-9 x its total rank variance
within_guard.why_added: run 1 printed rho_within = +0.000 for whowhen pairs whose x is constant inside every session (float noise instead of 0/0); numerical guard only

independent_units.rule: n_rep_independent_units counts only the A holdout of the discovery corpus and the B / A units of other corpora (plus the aiv_cu population table when the discovery unit is not aiv_cu/B); the swechat format strata are reported in per_unit but never counted (they are subsets of swechat/B)
independent_units.why_added: run 1-3 counted swechat/B and its format strata as separate replications for non-swechat discovery units, which double-counts one sample

followups.rule: per discovery unit and swechat formats: (F1) native_error coverage of results by shell / non-shell; (F2) share of calls whose issuing response has usage_out <= 10, overall and by is_subagent; (F3) share of calls with gap_prev_ms == 0; (F4) arg_len vs gap_prev_ms on calls whose previous event (seq-1) belongs to the same response (block streaming time) vs the rest, plus median arg chars per second of gap; (F5) lag-1 error autocorrelation over calls with a non-null err, observed vs 20 within-session permutations of err; (F6) model family (substring haiku/sonnet/opus of the call's model column) of subagent vs main calls; (F7) gap_input recomputed within the call's own stream (is_subagent + parent_call_id): negative-gap shares and its correlations with sub, resp_out, resp_think, resp_ctx, arg_len, lat_ms
followups.why_added: run 1 top lists: nerr_rate|shell_share and t_shell|nerr (F1); resp_out|sub and aiv_cc resp_out median 1 (F2); aiv_cu gap_prev_ms|resp_out sign opposite to other units (F3); arg_len|gap_prev_ms replicating in 7-8 units (F4); err|prev_err positive pooled but negative within-session in whowhen (F5); resp_out|sub, gap_input_ms|sub, resp_think|sub in swechat (F6); swechat gap_input_ms p5 is negative in the profile (F7)

call.lat_ms: result ts - call ts in ms (ts_kind event/row_insert only; shared_turn and none -> null)
call.hdur_ms: harness-reported duration on the result: extra.durationMs | durationSeconds*1000 | totalDurationMs | duration_s*1000
call.prog_s: max elapsed seconds over progress meta events with parent_call_id == call_id (bash_progress/mcp_progress)
call.res_len: characters of the result text (null when no result)
call.stderr_len: characters of the result stderr column (null when the column is null)
call.arg_len: characters of the call args JSON string
call.nerr: native_error of the result as 0/1 (null when native_error is null)
call.prev_err: err of the previous call in the session (call order = seq)
call.same_tool_prev: 1 if tool equals the previous call's tool in the session
call.pos_idx: 0-based ordinal of the call among the session's calls
call.pos_rel: pos_idx / (n_calls - 1) (null when the session has one call)
call.gap_prev_ms: call ts - ts of the previous event (seq order) that has a ts
call.gap_input_ms: call ts - max ts of earlier events of kind result/user/system (model turnaround)
call.resp_out: issuing response's usage_out: max over usage rows with the same (session_id, response key)
call.resp_ctx: issuing response's usage_in + usage_cache_read + usage_cache_create (max over its usage rows)
call.resp_think: sum of extra.thinking_chars (aiv_cu: extra.reasoning_chars) over assistant/call events of the issuing response; the call's own value when it has no response key
call.resp_ncalls: number of call events sharing the issuing response key (null when no key)
call.srv_ms: aiv_cu only: extra.timing.server_timing_dur_ms of the issuing turn (Gemini server timing)

session.err_rate: sum(err) / count(err non-null) over the session's calls
session.n_tools: distinct normalized tool names among calls
session.dur_s: max ts - min ts over events with a ts (seconds)
session.think_sum: sum of thinking/reasoning chars over assistant/call events
session.res_len_med: median res_len over the session's calls
session.calls_per_resp: n_calls / distinct response keys of calls

aiv_cu/population.note: turn-level population table; features differ in definition from the IR-based units
